item.title: Nido revenue rises to $85.8m as earnings target withdrawn and CFO resigns
item.description: Nido Education Limited has reported higher first-half revenue but lower earnings and a statutory loss, prompting the early childhood education and care operator to withdraw its FY2026 adjusted earnings growth target. The result follows the resignation of long-serving Chief Financial Officer Tom Herring, who will leave the company in November.

item.title: New Queensland Ombudsman appointment relevant to oversight of ECEC regulatory decisions
item.description: The appointment of Linda Waugh as Queensland’s new Ombudsman places an experienced public sector integrity leader at the head of an independent office responsible for examining the administrative actions and decisions of government agencies, including matters involving the regulation of early childhood education and care.

item.title: UN discussions advance possible global agreement recognising early childhood education as a right
item.description: Governments, experts, civil society organisations and child advocates are gathering in Geneva from 31 August to 2 September 2026 to advance discussions on a possible international agreement that would explicitly recognise early childhood care and education as part of every child’s right to education.
